name: motkra
description: Privacy-first AI coding agent — Claude (cloud) + any local model via Ollama

motkra.claudeModel.description: Anthropic model ID used for cloud requests.

motkra.privacyScan.description: Scan messages for secrets/credentials and force local model if found.

motkra.terminalTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the run_command agent tool.

motkra.allowedCommands.description: Executables the terminal tool is allowed to run.

motkra.proactiveErrors.description: Suggest fixes when VS Code diagnostics report errors on save.

motkra.proactiveTerminal.description: Detect crashes in terminal output and offer to diagnose them.

motkra.stuckDetection.description: Offer a second pair of eyes when you edit the same code region repeatedly.

motkra.inlineCompletions.description: Show ghost-text inline completions powered by the local Ollama model.

motkra.defaultLocalModel.description: Default local Ollama model for completions and fast responses.

motkra.braveSearchKey.description: Brave Search API key for the web_search tool. Free tier: 2,000 requests/day. Leave blank to use DuckDuckGo instant answers (limited).

motkra.allowScreenshot.description: Allow the take_screenshot agent tool to capture the VS Code editor and pass the image to Claude Vision.

motkra.workspaceIndex.description: Build a TF-IDF index of workspace files and inject relevant context into Claude requests.

motkra.workspaceIndexMaxKB.description: Maximum file size in KB to include in the workspace index.

motkra.voiceEnabled.description: Show microphone button for voice input via the VS Code Speech extension (ms-vscode.vscode-speech).

motkra.ttsEnabled.description: Read short Gemma responses aloud using VS Code Speech text-to-speech. Skips code blocks.

motkra.maxSubAgents.description: Maximum number of subtasks the /plan orchestrator will create and execute.
